description: React component for displaying and managing a user's wishlist in an e-commerce application, including fetching wishlist products, rendering product details, and removing items from the wishlist.

methods.name: Product
methods.description: React functional component that displays wishlist products, allows removal, and navigation to product details.

methods.name: removeFromWishList
methods.description: Removes a product from the wishlist stored in localStorage and refreshes the product list.

methods.name: fetchData
methods.description: Fetches wishlist products from API and updates component state.
